stem: Which figure does NOT belong with the others?
hints: Every figure uses a different shape, so the shape cannot be the rule. Look for something else.
Count the shapes in each figure.
Three figures have the same number of shapes. Find the one with a different count.

solution.methodName: Find the rule three of them share

steps.action: Check the shapes: diamond, triangle, square, star. Every figure uses a different shape, so the shape is not the rule.
steps.why: In odd-one-out items, look for something three figures share and one does not. A feature that is different in all four cannot be the rule.

steps.action: Check the colors: all four figures are black, so the color is not the rule either.
Count the shapes: ◆◆ has 2, ▲▲▲ has 3, ■■■ has 3, ★★★ has 3.
Three figures have 3 shapes. ◆◆ has only 2, so it breaks the rule. The answer is ◆◆.

trapNotes.▲▲▲: ▲▲▲ has 3 shapes, like ■■■ and ★★★. Its shape is different, but so is every figure's shape.
trapNotes.■■■: ■■■ has 3 shapes, like ▲▲▲ and ★★★, so it follows the rule.
trapNotes.★★★: A star may look like the odd shape, but every figure uses a different shape. ★★★ has 3 shapes, so it follows the rule.
